items.title: Reindeer in a Green Velvet Cape
items.alt: Gray-blue-eyed cartoon reindeer lifting one forehoof in a cream-edged green velvet cape with a gold clasp.
items.description: A small red bow decorates one antler above the reindeer's long pale muzzle. The short capelet leaves its cream chest, four legs and curled tail silhouette clearly visible.

items.title: Two Reindeer Touching Noses
items.alt: Large chestnut cartoon reindeer gently touching noses with a smaller gray-brown reindeer, both standing with complete bodies.
items.description: The larger animal's heavy antler crown contrasts with the smaller one's short forks and round cream cheeks. Their inward-facing heads create a gentle shared focal point.

items.title: Reindeer Watching a Little Toy Train
items.alt: Gray cartoon reindeer lying with folded forelegs beside a small red wooden locomotive, wearing a long green scarf.
items.description: The reindeer lowers its broad cream muzzle toward the toy's green roof. Tall antlers, bright green eyes and the scarf's trailing fringe distinguish the resting figure.

items.title: Reindeer Marching with a Gold Star Wand
items.alt: Violet-eyed golden cartoon reindeer taking an upright marching step while holding a gold star wand between its forehooves.
items.description: A red-and-cream striped bow sits below the reindeer's curled forelock. One lifted rear hoof and the upright star wand give the compact character a bright parade pose.

items.title: Sleepy Reindeer Beside a Gift Sack
items.alt: Sleepy brown cartoon reindeer resting its cheek against a full green gift sack, with two rear hooves forward and a gold bell collar.
items.description: The sack's thick gold drawstring hangs beside the reindeer's half-closed eyes. Broad antlers, cream eyebrows and a pale neck ruff distinguish the relaxed seated figure.

items.title: Reindeer Leaping over a Candy Cane
items.alt: Green-eyed cartoon reindeer in a short blue scarf leaping sideways over a low red-and-white candy cane arch.
items.description: Four separate tucked hooves float above the striped arch. A smiling long face, broad antlers and wind-swept fringed scarf emphasize the forward motion.
